review.purpose: Establish eligible unseen-item ceilings from the built-in relation before interpreting a fitted recommendation.
review.finding: Ten interactions span four users and three items. Two users have no unseen candidate; u3/u4 have only C and receive it. Full population left join preserves exhausted users; this planted example does not measure prediction accuracy.

review.purpose: Audit novel recommendation populations, ranks and proposed exposure while varying maximum slate size at fixed input/model settings.
review.finding: Seven learners receive fourteen default recommendations and twenty-one in the three-slot experiment; L08 remains in the population with zero because all items were observed. Counts concern proposed lists, not delivery or engagement; blank observations are unknown rather than negative feedback.

review.purpose: Compare independently fitted single-user results with that user’s all-user rows and distinguish unknown from exhausted users.
review.finding: Single-user item identities/ranks agree and scores differ by less than 1e-6 from all-user output at matching settings. Unknown NEW returns zero; known L08 returns zero because every module was seen. Checks explicitly verify both zero populations and API agreement; no invented fallback is returned.
